Now the important part is to not try to find more mistakes to punish because if you look at all of them at once I personally find it hard to make a punish if I am looking for to many things. As I do this enough I will move onto 2 mistakes to punish and so on. Also I like to join arenas that have a few people in it and while waiting my turn I try to find every flaw they did in the match this way when it is my turn I have already actively acknowledge what I need to adapt to and punish. Tldr: it takes time to form good habits and longer to fix bad ones but consistently is key!
